title: Nourishing Velvety Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A rich and flavorful Algerian dish featuring tender lamb, fresh thyme, and a blend of aromatic spices, slow cooked to perfection in a velvety tagine sauce. This recipe is ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly and dehydrates the lamb to enhance the umami flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the lamb, thyme, olive oil, onion, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Let the lamb mixture dehydrate for 2 hours.
In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat.
Add the dehydrated lamb mixture to the pot and cook until browned on all sides.
Add 2 cups of water to the pot and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer to the preheated oven.
Braise the tagine for 2.5 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the sauce is velvety.
Remove the pot from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh thyme and crusty bread on the side.
